# Floodlight and Campaign Manager 360

Apply the [media contract](../../media/common.md) and its linked implementation owners.

## Resolve the activity and architecture

Establish Floodlight configuration ID, activity group/tag strings, Counter/Sales type, counting
method, optimization/audience use and approved custom variables. Activity creation/trafficking are
platform inputs. Inspect linked Google destinations, pushed/approved activities, existing Google
tags/linkers and native Counter/Sales or Google-tag architecture. Linking and Approval Queue actions
retain their explicit external/high-impact authority.

Reconcile site-wide initialization, activity tags, iframe/image paths, automatic loading and shared
Ads/GA4 consumers. Stable reusable IDs can use constants. Configuration `src`, group/type,
activity/category, counting method and custom variables remain distinct except where the installed
native field expressly combines them.

## Map Counter and Sales

Counter uses its documented counting method/parameters. Sales maps approved revenue/value, applicable
currency, quantity, actual order identity and duplicate-counting semantics. Custom variables belong
to the activity's approved non-PII analytical fields. Native template-owned cache-busting/order
mechanics retain their documented owner. Product data uses the actual feed convention and complete
projection under [mapping](../../data/mapping.md).

## Coordinate consent and attribution

[Google consent](../../consent/google.md) owns compatible policies across shared Google/Floodlight/
linker execution units. [Linker architecture](../../web/linker-cross-domain.md) owns attribution and
domain decisions. Any selected user-provided-data feature uses its separately approved identity route.

## Verify

Check exact activity identifiers, counting method, fields, initialization, consent and linker graph.
Record activity creation/linking, custom-variable definitions, dynamic settings, enhanced attribution
and platform validation as external dependencies.

- https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/7554821

## Server route

For server delivery, load [Server](server.md). Select Counter/Sales from the exact activity and
reconcile direct browser overlap through the current Google migration contract.
